questions.question: Is our Todoist integration API-driven or MCP-driven? Compare staying with Todoist, a new Linear team, Google Keep and other suitable alternatives; which execution approach is fastest and most reliable?
Can we automate access to these services? Assess available APIs/MCPs, existing connected access, browser-only gaps, expected benefit and scope. Do not implement before the follow-up is selected.

implementationScope: Assessment only. No platform migration, new connections, publication, purchases or advertising changes.

taskPlatformAssessment.currentPath: Bot -> local execution-tools MCP -> deterministic code -> managed Composio MCP broker -> Todoist API. Full queue reads additionally use the local attention service.

observedBottleneck.targetedProgressReads: Already fetch a single task by ID.

taskPlatformAssessment.recommendation: Keep Todoist for the next efficiency increment; improve bounded pagination, incremental ingestion and indexed retrieval. Evaluate Linear for richer objective/project workflows, not as an assumed latency or token saving.
taskPlatformAssessment.linearAccess: Connected Positronics workspace verified by get_workspace and list_teams. Existing teams: Positron Flux Development (FLUX), Marketing Development (MKT), Sales (CASH), Company Administration (ADM).

alternatives.name: Todoist
alternatives.assessment: Lowest migration effort; public API, Sync batching/incremental reads, official MCP and webhooks. Current managed connector is functional; direct API needs separately provisioned credentials.

alternatives.name: Linear
alternatives.assessment: Better native structure for company objectives through initiatives, projects and issues. GraphQL API, MCP and webhooks. Existing teams can be reused; no new team is inherently necessary. No migration or speed benchmark performed.

alternatives.name: Google Keep
alternatives.assessment: Poor execution-system fit: enterprise note administration API, with no note-update method in the published REST reference; not a substitute for an objective/task workflow.

alternatives.name: Google Tasks
alternatives.assessment: Already reported connected; reasonable personal checklist API, not the preferred shared business-objective system.

alternatives.name: Local indexed execution cache
alternatives.assessment: Code-operated cache and work queue can avoid repeated remote scans. It should preserve the selected external system as the human-facing source of truth rather than introduce a second independently edited backlog.

taskPlatformAssessment.executorRecommendation: Stable operations run in code, exposed through MCP for agent access. Jev only for bounded classification. DeepSeek Flash is a candidate for residual established executor work against Haiku/Luna fixtures; there is no current benchmark establishing the fastest model. Do not force max reasoning for mechanical tasks or rebalance Sol/Opus without evidence.

serviceAssessment.evidence: Public developer documentation found is merchant/POS order handling, not a customer checkout API. No customer-order adapter found in inspected tool/config inventory.
serviceAssessment.nextCapability: Discover customer catalog/cart/quote operations in a separate authorized session or existing recordings, then qualify bounded operations. Exact meal, fees and total remain part of approval.

serviceAssessment.maturity: Official MCP available; not configured in inspected runtime
serviceAssessment.evidence: Gustave currently has browser-oriented Perk skills. Official MCP provides search, trip data and checkout links; security docs explicitly exclude completing/paying, modifying or cancelling confirmed bookings. OAuth, role/plan and callback compatibility remain unverified.
serviceAssessment.nextCapability: Connect and qualify the official MCP, then automate repeated searches and quote comparisons while preserving the existing checkout boundary.

serviceAssessment.evidence: Confirmed selver-bff.mjs and selver-cart-bff.mjs installed; enabled selver-shopping skill uses authenticated account/cart reads, quantity updates and deterministic ingredient audits. Current login and cart were not exercised.
serviceAssessment.nextCapability: Verify and harden existing clients and session recovery, expose small typed operations if useful, and retain deterministic cart/ingredient reconciliation. No replacement browser automation is needed for established cart operations.

serviceAssessment.evidence: No public customer-cart API or local adapter verified. Official store supports saved/repeated shopping workflows, but that does not establish a programmable checkout contract.
serviceAssessment.nextCapability: Discover catalog, account-cart, substitutions and delivery-slot operations; start with a verified cart and price quote before payment.

serviceAssessment.evidence: Attendee-platform skill is enabled. Official support describes the attendee web app, meeting requests and connection exports; a public attendee automation API was not found in this review.
serviceAssessment.nextCapability: Reuse exports and discover stable read/request/status operations. Distinguish invitations from accepted meetings when synchronizing calendars.

serviceAssessment.evidence: Meeting-tool skill is enabled. Official platform supports calendar sync. No public attendee request/search API verified.
serviceAssessment.nextCapability: Automate directory/agenda ingestion and request-status reconciliation first; qualify meeting requests separately.

serviceAssessment.maturity: Local CSV and audit already exist
serviceAssessment.evidence: Current audit is hardcoded to one launch publication register. Its live execution record references a comms-calendar CSV mirror; Google Calendar and Sheets connectors are active, but neither is established here as the canonical marketing calendar.
serviceAssessment.nextCapability: Resolve and preserve the actual canonical calendar; generalize deterministic scheduling/reconciliation across all objectives, with exact time zones, content hashes, scoped approvals, per-channel jobs and publication readback.

serviceAssessment.maturity: Official posting API; no broker connection listed
serviceAssessment.evidence: Official API supports posting and media workflows. Pricing is pay-per-use; cited page lists $0.015/post and $0.20/post containing a URL, subject to current account rates. Auth and funded access not verified.
serviceAssessment.nextCapability: Use the official API with scoped authorization, media upload, exact-copy preservation and duplicate-safe readback instead of browser posting.

serviceAssessment.maturity: Official API; existing browser publishing skill
serviceAssessment.evidence: No Mastodon connection in managed connector inventory. Native status API supports posting, scheduled_at and Idempotency-Key.
serviceAssessment.nextCapability: Provision instance-specific OAuth and qualify one-channel text/image/schedule/readback adapter.

serviceAssessment.maturity: Official API; existing browser publishing skill
serviceAssessment.evidence: No Threads connection in managed connector inventory. Meta official collection exposes text/image/video containers and publishing; OAuth/app setup needed.
serviceAssessment.nextCapability: Qualify container creation, media readiness, publication and permalink readback as one bounded channel operation.

serviceAssessment.evidence: Managed positron account is ACTIVE; GET_MY_INFO succeeded. Posting and image-upload schemas discovered. Organization admin rights, write scopes and company-page publishing were not tested.
serviceAssessment.nextCapability: Qualify personal versus company-page authority and media posting; wrap exact-content publishing and readback in code.

serviceAssessment.maturity: Restricted API access; browser skill exists
serviceAssessment.evidence: Ordinary LinkedIn connection does not grant Sales Navigator API access. Official SNAP partner approval is required for relevant API permissions; entitlement not verified.
serviceAssessment.nextCapability: Prefer available supported CRM/SNAP integration. Otherwise bounded browser discovery remains necessary; do not promise general API-based prospect search from the existing connector.

serviceAssessment.maturity: Official AT Protocol API; existing browser publishing skill
serviceAssessment.evidence: No Bluesky connection in managed connector inventory. Public API documents post creation, blobs and URI/CID results. Direct app-password/OAuth credentials were not verified.
serviceAssessment.nextCapability: Qualify a one-channel adapter for exact copy, rich-text links, image blobs, alt text and publication reconciliation.

serviceAssessment.evidence: work account ACTIVE; account-summary call succeeded. Report metric/dimension combinations and property-level reporting still need qualification. Google also publishes a read-only MCP.
serviceAssessment.nextCapability: Build fixed reporting queries, campaign/UTM joins and reproducible summaries; keep arithmetic in code and interpretation with the lead.

serviceAssessment.evidence: positron account ACTIVE; report and campaign schemas discovered. No ad-account report was executed and no spend changed. Official Ads API is open to developers with OAuth, with adsread and adsedit scopes.
serviceAssessment.nextCapability: Start with deterministic reporting and budget checks; separately qualify approved campaign mutations with before/after verification.

proposedBusinessIncrements.outcome: Leads receive current changed/actionable work without repeatedly rereading the whole backlog.
proposedBusinessIncrements.engineeringAssessment: High confidence: improve existing Todoist ingestion and compact indexed retrieval. No migration required.

proposedBusinessIncrements.outcome: Approved social posts appear on time with the correct copy and image, with verified receipts.
proposedBusinessIncrements.engineeringAssessment: High potential: qualify Bluesky and Mastodon separately, then Threads/LinkedIn/X as credentials and scopes permit. Compose channels only after separate reliable runs.

proposedBusinessIncrements.outcome: Travel requests produce comparable Perk options and usable checkout links without browser walkthroughs.
proposedBusinessIncrements.engineeringAssessment: Official MCP reduces discovery effort; one-time OAuth and account capability verification required.

proposedBusinessIncrements.outcome: Marketing receives a reproducible performance report without agents transcribing dashboards.
proposedBusinessIncrements.engineeringAssessment: Google Analytics and Reddit Ads connectors already active; reporting schemas and metrics need qualification.

proposedBusinessIncrements.outcome: The Dude returns a correctly audited Selver cart matching the meal plan and budget.
proposedBusinessIncrements.engineeringAssessment: Existing BFF clients mean verification, recovery and bounded workflow hardening are the next work, not a fresh integration.

selectionRule: These are engineering recommendations. Marco selects business value and the next increment; no fixed roadmap or additional rollout is implied.
